mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 3% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 6% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST and a fall in RSAFS over the same month signals weakening housing demand and reduced mortgage lending, which negatively impacts construction and home-related equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month AND RSAFS < previous month in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month drop in FEDFUNDS below 1% while CPIAUCSL is rising above 3% YoY signals a policy-lag environment where monetary easing has not yet translated to lower inflation, creating uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops > 0.5% in one month AND CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated decline in GDPC1 and INDPRO below their respective 6-month moving averages for two consecutive months signals broad-based demand and supply weakness, which depresses earnings and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of regime.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 6-month MA AND INDPRO < 6-month MA for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.
